name: AI Cookbook
description: Production-ready patterns, prompting techniques, and agent architectures for building with AI. From 4M Labs.

prompting-techniques.label: Prompting Techniques
prompting-techniques.description: 16 proven methods for structuring AI prompts — from zero-shot to agent orchestration.

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
items.description: Guide the model through step-by-step reasoning before arriving at an answer.

items.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
items.description: Get useful output from a model with no examples — just a clear instruction.

items.title: Few-Shot Prompting
items.description: Provide a handful of examples to teach the model the pattern you want.

items.title: ReAct Prompting
items.description: Combine reasoning and acting — the model thinks, then calls tools, then thinks again.

items.title: Tree of Thoughts
items.description: Explore multiple reasoning branches in parallel and backtrack when needed.

items.title: Role Prompting
items.description: Assign a persona or expertise to the model to shape tone, depth, and domain.

items.title: Self-Consistency
items.description: Sample multiple reasoning paths and pick the most common answer.

items.title: ART Prompting
items.description: Automatic Reasoning and Tool-use — let the model select and chain tools autonomously.

items.title: Automatic Prompt Engineering
items.description: Use AI to optimize its own prompts — generate variants and score them.

items.title: Agent Prompting
items.description: Structure prompts that give models agency — goals, tools, memory, and loops.
